stories.title: A "Jane Doe" in the R. Kelly trials is ready to share her real name. And her story.
stories.summary: A once anonymous R. Kelly survivor, Reshona Landfair is now ready to reclaim her voice.

stories.title: Olympic athletes protest big oil
stories.summary: Several athletes are objecting to the International Olympic Committee over sponsorship of the Games by major oil companies. They say fossil fuel use threatens winter conditions needed for snow sports.

stories.title: More frustrated prosecutors at the U.S Attorney's office in Minnesota call it quits
stories.summary: Turmoil continues at the U.S. Attorney's office in Minneapolis. This week another attorney was removed from a special assignment dealing with immigration cases after telling a judge she hates her job.

stories.title: Father James Martin chronicles the meandering path that brought him to the priesthood
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Father James Martin about his new book Work in Progress: Confessions of a busboy, dishwasher, caddy, usher, factory worker, bank teller, corporate tool, and priest.

stories.title: Metal band Megadeth and Harry Styles each hit No. 1 this week on the Billboard Charts
stories.summary: NPR Music's Stephen Thompson reports on new music shaping the charts.

stories.title: Can't solve a puzzle? Sleep on it, a new study suggests
stories.summary: NPR's Short Wave talks about babies' perceptions of rhythm, how sleep may help us solve puzzles and why snakes may be able to fast so long.
